name: Lafayette Parish, LA
findings: Lafayette Parish has 706 nonprofit organizations. 267 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 235 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lafayette Parish has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 14 economic development organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.
